name: Gabrielle's Zombie Attack
summary:
Gabrielle was just minding her own business one day, when a horde of overzealous zombies decided to try to make a meal of her! Luckily, there's one thing these zombies don't like: Mandrake plants! In this first-person zombie zapper, you'll toss mandrakes at these undead ne'er-do-wells and take back the night!

Can you fight back these persistent zombie hordes, or will Gabrielle end up being a midnight snack? Help Gabrielle with her corpse conundrum!
